svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print a pair for each size used: 34 mm bore for the design point.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A set from 20 to 45 mm covers the head and flow range.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Body: 50 mm outside, 25 mm long, fits the seat in the nozzle tip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flange: 64 mm across, 3 mm thick, with two 4.4 mm holes 57 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore: converges smoothly from 46 mm at the back to the jet size at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the front face; the last few millimetres must be round and sharp.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print with the front face down on the bed so the jet edge is clean.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ream or sand the bore to size; check it with a caliper.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slide into the nozzle tip from inside the housing, two M4

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bore is within 0.2 mm of size and round.
